## Git Health Assessment — FleetHQ Repository

### Hot Zones
- **kilo family**: 228 requests, 199 OK (87.3% success), avg latency 8,482ms — carries 96% of total load (2376 requests). Single point of failure.
- **ovh family**: 4 requests, 3 OK, 1 rate429 — healthy but minimal traffic.
- **llm7 family**: 1 request, 0 OK, rate429 hit — failing.
- **pollinations family**: 1 request, 0 OK, net error — failing.

### Documentation Gaps
- llm7 and pollinations families have zero successful responses but no fallback routing documented.
- fleet-census shows 27 domain files across 2 repos (fleet-vault private, FleetHQ public) — no migration runbook found.
- Crew of 6 members (aluf, gal, erez, tamar, shachar, yarden) — no ownership matrix in books.

### Migration Risks
- 96% concentration on kilo family violates 'one provider must never consume the whole walk' (evening law, Task 27).
- No reordering by measured family health before budgets burn (telemetry law, Task 28-b).
- Failed families (llm7, pollinations) have cooldown multipliers of 4x and 1x respectively — inconsistent recovery strategy.

### Recommendations
1. Re-route traffic from kilo to ovh based on telemetry health scores.
2. Document fallback routing for llm7 and pollinations.
3. Create migration runbook for fleet-vault private repo.
4. Assign ownership matrix for 27 domain files.

reports.title: Ethereum Network Health & Adoption Report
reports.body:
# Ethereum Network Health & Adoption Report

## Key Metrics (Source: cryptorank.io, sqmagazine.co.uk)

### Network Activity
- **Daily Transactions**: ~1.74 million (August 2025 record), up from ~1.16M avg in 2024 (+11.8% YoY)
- **New Addresses**: 187,000 created in past 30 days (highest since early 2024)
- **Active Wallets**: ~700,000 daily in early 2025, peaks near 930,000 (July 2025)
- **Wallet Creation**: +33% YoY in 2025, weekly hits 800K-1M

### Health Indicators
- **Staked Supply**: 30.2% of ETH staked (PoS participation)
- **Gas Fees**: ~84% drop in 2025, now ~0.09 Gwei
- **Smart Contract Calls**: 7M+ daily average (2024)

### Adoption Signals
- DeFi, NFT utility, and stablecoin usage driving growth
- Diverse geographic distribution of new addresses
- Dencun upgrade (March 2024) enabled blob transactions for L2 scaling

## Assessment
Network health is strong with record transaction volumes, growing address creation, and declining fees indicating sustainable adoption rather than speculative spikes.

reports.title: סקירת פancelס הלקחים Chief — learning-summary
reports.body:
** Origin: learning-summary (age 1.2h, read 2026-10-10T13:01:09.536Z) **

** Lessons in book: 4 **

---

### Lesson 1: Provider family quota management
Frequency: 2/4 | Severity: HIGH
"One provider family burning its quota must never consume the whole walk (evening law, Task 27)"
Risk: Single-family dependency can collapse entire patrol routes.

### Lesson 2: Re-order walk by measured family health
Frequency: 2/4 | Severity: HIGH
"Re-order the walk by measured family health BEFORE budgets burn (telemetry law, Task 28-b)"
Risk: Prioritizing by budget rather than health metrics wastes resources.

### Lesson 3: Claims without live measurement are rumors
Frequency: 1/4 | Severity: MEDIUM
"Claims without a live measurement are rumors — refuted 2 of own claims today (Task 28-b)"
Risk: Unverified claims propagate false operational pictures.

### Lesson 4: Books ARE the office
Frequency: 1/4 | Severity: MEDIUM
"The floor looks dead when books are missing even if every service is up — books ARE the office"
Risk: Missing books create illusion of operational blindness even when systems are live.

---

### Gaps / Unaddressed Patterns:
- No lesson recorded on cross-check failures or operator override events
- No lesson on SOVEREIGN GATEWAY handling (429 errors, automatic failover)
- No lesson on tool call efficiency (single-tool-per-message constraint)

---

### Improvement Suggestion:
** Add a "Verification Gate" step to all patrol walks **
Before any claim enters the operational record, it must pass through a mandatory cross_check tool call against at least one live measurement source. This directly addresses Lesson 3 (claims = rumors) and operationalizes Lesson 2 (telemetry before action). Cost: 1 extra tool call per claim. Benefit: Eliminates rumor-based decisions, reduces re-work from refuted claims by estimated 50%.

reports.title: שיפור מוחשי: סדר הליכה לפי בריאות משפחה נמדדת
reports.body:
**מה משתנה**: משנים את אלגוריתם סדר ההליכה (walk order) כך שיתעדף משפחות ספקים לפי מדד בריאות חי (latency, error rate, quota headroom) *לפני* שכל תקציב נשרף — מיישם את 'telemetry law' (Task 28-b) ומגן מפני 'evening law' (Task 27).

**אחראי**: קצין טלמטריה (Telemetry Officer) — בעל ספר fleet-indicators.

**מדד הצלחה**: אפס מקרים של משפחה אחת שצורכת >80% מההליכה בזמן שמשפחות אחרות בריאות (מדוד ב-fleet-indicators כל 5 דק׳).

**לו״ז**: פריסה לשלב-ביניים תוך 3 ימים (2026-10-13), מלא תוך 10 ימים (2026-10-20).

**בסיס נתונים**: פנקס הלקחים עודכן 2026-10-10T13:01:09.536Z (גיל 1.2h); לקח 28-b הופרך 2 טענות עצמיות היום — הוכחה שמדידה חיה עובדת.

reports.body:
**ממצאים ממדידה ישירה**

1. **capability-matrix** (נמדד 2026-10-10T12:15:01.099Z) — מכיל 4 יכולות חיות (live) ו-3 ממתינות (waiting). אף אחת מהיכולות החיות אינה "ניתוח היסטוריית גיט" או "קריאת קומיטים".

2. **registry** (נמדד 2026-10-10T12:15:01.099Z) — 6 סוכנים בצוות. לאף סוכן אין ספר/יכולת מוגדרת לניתוח גיט (git log/history). הסוכן הקרוב ביותר: shachar (מודיעין) עם fleet-indicators, fleet-census, pulse-book, learning-summary.

3. **git_report** — הכלי החזיר "לא זמין" פעמיים, כלומר אין כרגע יכולת מבצעית להפקת דוח קומיטים מהספרים.

**פערים שזוהו**
- חסר סוכן/יכולת ייעודית לניתוח היסטוריית גיט (commit patterns, trends, gaps).
- חסר ספר/כלי שמחלץ מטא-דאטה של קומיטים (תדירות, מחברים, אזורים, דפוסי שמות).
- capability-matrix לא כולל capability כזו ב-live ולא ב-waiting.

**המלצה**
להוסיף ל-capability-matrix יכולת "git history analysis" ב-waiting עם צורך: "סוכן/כלי שמריץ git log, מחלץ דפוסים, ומפיק דוח תקופתי". לשקול הקצאה ל-shachar (מודיעין) או סוכן ייעודי חדש.

reports.title: Capability Matrix vs FleetHQ Sync Validation
reports.body:
**Sync Discrepancies Found:**

1. **Brain Count Mismatch**: capability-matrix claims "sovereign gateway: 44+ brains" but fleet-indicators shows only 4 LLM families total, with only 1 family (kilo) actively serving traffic (218 requests, 182 ok). The other 3 families (llm7, pollinations, ovh) show 0 requests — these may be the "waiting" capabilities but the count is far from 44+.

2. **Repo Count Mismatch**: capability-matrix lists 7 capabilities (4 live + 3 waiting) but mirror shows only 2 repos: FleetHQ (public) and fleet-vault (private). fleet-census confirms same 2 repos.

3. **Waiting Capabilities Not Reflected**: The 3 waiting capabilities in matrix (air-gapped local brain, duckai free bridge, zero-touch boot) have no corresponding entries in fleet-indicators or fleet-census — they appear as planned but not yet deployed to FleetHQ.

4. **Active vs Total**: fleet-indicators totals show 1967 requests, 1956 answered, 10 failed — but only kilo family has traffic. The matrix's live capabilities don't align with actual traffic distribution.

**Data Points Read**: fleet-indicators at 2026-10-10T10:54:59.481Z (1967 total requests), mirror at 2026-10-10T10:52:59.467Z (2 repos).
